# Command reference

<!-- generated by docs/gen_cli.py from jlcplace's argument parser: edit the parser's help, then run
     `python docs/gen_cli.py` (tests/test_docs.py fails when this page is out of date) -->

Every command takes `-v` / `--verbose` (log what the EasyEDA client does), before or after the command name.
`BOARD` is a `.kicad_pcb` file or a JSON snapshot written by [`jlcplace snapshot`](#jlcplace-snapshot).
Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes and environment](./environment).

## jlcplace check

Simulate a CPL against the board.

Simulate every CPL row with JLC's EasyEDA footprint and report where its pads land.

```text
jlcplace check [options] BOARD CPL
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD` | the KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) or a JSON snapshot of it |
| `CPL` | the CPL to check: from any tool (CSV/TSV, or KiCad's .pos) |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--db` `DIR` | correction database directory (one JSON file per LCSC code) |
| `--reading` `{jlc-2022,ccw-from-top,ccw-from-top+180,jlc-2022+180}` | how JLC reads a bottom-side rotation (default jlc-2022) |
| `--units` `{mm,in,mil}` | unit of bare numbers in the CPL (KiCad's CSV position file does not say; default mm) |
| `--fixed-cpl` `CSV` | when every row is off by one origin, unit or y axis: write the CPL with that taken out (its rows moved onto the Gerbers' origin, or the CPL origin: then right only for Gerbers plotted from it, which --gerbers checks), and check it |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

### EasyEDA records

| | |
|---|---|
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--online` | download the records the cache lacks from the EasyEDA API (rate-limited; default: only cached records, which `jlcplace fetch` downloads) |
| `--offline` | only cached records (the default) |

### Reports

| | |
|---|---|
| `--fail-on` `{red,yellow}` | exit 1 on yellow too (default: red only) |
| `--report` `HTML` | write the HTML report |
| `--json` `PATH` | write the results as JSON ('-' for stdout) |
| `--junit` `XML` | write JUnit XML |
| `--checklist` `PATH` | write the preview checklist (.md, or .csv) |
| `--github-annotations` | print GitHub Actions annotations |
| `--bom` `CSV` | the JLC BOM: codes for parts that lack one, and consistency checks |
| `--gerbers` `GERBERS` | the Gerbers ordered with the CPL (a directory, a .zip or one file): JLC lays the CPL over them from their own (0, 0), which becomes the CPL origin; red when the CPL was written from another origin or the Gerbers are not this board's as it is |
| `--overlay` `DIR` | write top.svg and bottom.svg (and PNGs when a renderer is at hand) of the board as JLC's preview shows it, problem parts circled (draws EasyEDA outlines: for your own review) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no terminal summary |

## jlcplace cpl

Write a corrected CPL and check it.

Write the CPL JLC needs (corrections from --db, else fitted), check the written file, and refuse to keep it when a row is red.

```text
jlcplace cpl --output CPL [options] BOARD
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD` | the KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) or a JSON snapshot of it |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--db` `DIR` | correction database directory (one JSON file per LCSC code) |
| `--reading` `{jlc-2022,ccw-from-top,ccw-from-top+180,jlc-2022+180}` | how JLC reads a bottom-side rotation (default jlc-2022) |
| `-o`, `--output` `CPL` | where to write the CPL |
| `--force` | write the CPL even when rows are red (exit code still 2) |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

### EasyEDA records

| | |
|---|---|
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--online` | download the records the cache lacks from the EasyEDA API (rate-limited; default: only cached records, which `jlcplace fetch` downloads) |
| `--offline` | only cached records (the default) |

### Reports

| | |
|---|---|
| `--fail-on` `{red,yellow}` | exit 1 on yellow too (default: red only) |
| `--report` `HTML` | write the HTML report |
| `--json` `PATH` | write the results as JSON ('-' for stdout) |
| `--junit` `XML` | write JUnit XML |
| `--checklist` `PATH` | write the preview checklist (.md, or .csv) |
| `--github-annotations` | print GitHub Actions annotations |
| `--bom` `CSV` | the JLC BOM: codes for parts that lack one, and consistency checks |
| `--gerbers` `GERBERS` | the Gerbers ordered with the CPL (a directory, a .zip or one file): JLC lays the CPL over them from their own (0, 0), which becomes the CPL origin; red when the CPL was written from another origin or the Gerbers are not this board's as it is |
| `--overlay` `DIR` | write top.svg and bottom.svg (and PNGs when a renderer is at hand) of the board as JLC's preview shows it, problem parts circled (draws EasyEDA outlines: for your own review) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no terminal summary |

## jlcplace fit

Fit corrections (store them with --db).

```text
jlcplace fit [options] BOARD
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD` | the KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) or a JSON snapshot of it |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--db` `DIR` | correction database directory (one JSON file per LCSC code) |
| `--ref` `REF` | only these parts (repeatable) |
| `--json` `PATH` | write the fits as JSON ('-' for stdout) |
| `--fail-on` `{red,yellow}` | exit 1 on a yellow fit too (default: red only) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no terminal summary |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

### EasyEDA records

| | |
|---|---|
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--online` | download the records the cache lacks from the EasyEDA API (rate-limited; default: only cached records, which `jlcplace fetch` downloads) |
| `--offline` | only cached records (the default) |

## jlcplace fetch

Download EasyEDA records into the cache.

```text
jlcplace fetch [options] BOARD|CODE [BOARD|CODE ...]
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD|CODE` | boards (every LCSC code on them) and/or LCSC codes such as C7519 |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--refresh` | fetch again even when cached |
| `--min-interval` `S` | seconds between requests |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

## jlcplace confirm

Record a verification in the database.

Record that a part's placement was checked: manual (datasheet), preview (JLC's placement preview) or board (the assembled board). What was checked is the row of the CPL that was uploaded (--cpl, needed for preview and board), moved by the keys pressed in the preview; its correction is stored when it differs from the database's. Fits and stores a correction first when the database has none.

```text
jlcplace confirm --ref REF --db DIR --by NAME --source {board,preview,manual} [options] BOARD
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD` | the KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) or a JSON snapshot of it |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--reading` `{jlc-2022,ccw-from-top,ccw-from-top+180,jlc-2022+180}` | how JLC reads a bottom-side rotation (default jlc-2022) |
| `--ref` `REF` | the part that was checked (repeatable) |
| `--cpl` `CPL` | the CPL that was uploaded to JLC (what was checked; the presses are relative to its rows) |
| `--units` `{mm,in,mil}` | unit of bare numbers in the CPL (default mm) |
| `--db` `DIR` | correction database directory to record it in |
| `--by` `NAME` | who checked it |
| `--source` `{board,preview,manual}` | what was checked: manual (datasheet), preview (JLC's preview) or board (assembled) |
| `--note` `NOTE` | free text stored with the verification |
| `--failed` | the check showed the placement wrong (marks it red) |
| `--space` `SPACE` | space presses in JLC's preview (90 deg ccw each) |
| `--right` `RIGHT` | right-arrow presses (negative: left) |
| `--up` `UP` | up-arrow presses (negative: down) |
| `--rot` `ROT` | type the correction in: rot (degrees) ... |
| `--dx` `DX` | ... and the EasyEDA origin in the library frame, mm |
| `--dy` `DY` | ... in mm (with --rot and --dx) |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

### EasyEDA records

| | |
|---|---|
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--online` | download the records the cache lacks from the EasyEDA API (rate-limited; default: only cached records, which `jlcplace fetch` downloads) |
| `--offline` | only cached records (the default) |

## jlcplace show

Show what jlcplace knows about a code or part.

```text
jlcplace show [options] CODE|BOARD
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `CODE|BOARD` | an LCSC code, or a board with --ref |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `--db` `DIR` | correction database directory (one JSON file per LCSC code) |
| `--reading` `{jlc-2022,ccw-from-top,ccw-from-top+180,jlc-2022+180}` | how JLC reads a bottom-side rotation (default jlc-2022) |
| `--ref` `REF` | with BOARD: the part to show |
| `--json` `PATH` | write it as JSON ('-' for stdout) |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |

### EasyEDA records

| | |
|---|---|
| `--cache` `DIR` | record cache (default ~/.cache/jlcplace) |
| `--online` | download the records the cache lacks from the EasyEDA API (rate-limited; default: only cached records, which `jlcplace fetch` downloads) |
| `--offline` | only cached records (the default) |

## jlcplace snapshot

Save the board as JSON (checks without KiCad).

```text
jlcplace snapshot --output JSON [options] BOARD
```

**Arguments**

| | |
|---|---|
| `BOARD` | the KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) or a JSON snapshot of it |

### Options

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbose` | log what the EasyEDA client does |
| `-o`, `--output` `JSON` | where to write the snapshot |

### Board

| | |
|---|---|
| `--origin` `ORIGIN` | CPL origin: aux (default), grid, absolute, or 'X,Y' in mm or with a unit ('4in,-500mil'); check and cpl with --gerbers take the Gerbers' (0, 0), and an --origin elsewhere is red |
| `--lcsc-field` `NAME` | footprint field holding the LCSC code, searched before the usual names (repeatable) |
| `--reader` `{auto,pcbnew,sexpr,json}` | how to read BOARD (auto: .json is a snapshot, else pcbnew if it imports, else sexpr) |
